steps.title: Agent checks the cause with four tools
steps.what: Each wake-up runs a tool loop: weather, traffic, carrier and dock are checked in one parallel turn, and the biggest explained delay wins.
steps.code:
resp = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=16000,
                              tools=TOOLS, messages=msgs)
while resp.stop_reason == 'tool_use':
    results = [run(b) for b in resp.content if b.type == 'tool_use']
    msgs += [assistant(resp.content), user(results)]  # all results, one message

steps.title: Score causes and warning time against the answer key
steps.what: Ops leads hand-labelled the true cause of every flagged shipment; we score the agent and the warning time.
steps.code:
acc = mean(case.cause == key[sid]['true_cause'] for sid, case in cases)
warning_new = window_end - flagged_at
warning_old = window_end - customer_called_at   # negative = after the fact

story.situation: A regional 3PL runs about 400 loads a day. Dispatchers learn a load is late when the customer calls, then dig through four systems and type the same apology email by hand.
story.constraints: The agent may not move freight on its own: every reroute, rebook or new appointment needs a dispatcher's click. Customer emails must match each account's agreed tone. The agent should only wake when a promise is at risk, to keep cost and noise down.
story.replay: Reuse: 'watch a stream, wake an agent on a signal, human approves' fits any SLA desk (field service, claims, IT incidents). Next time: link traffic incidents to their cause (a storm-closed lane is a weather problem), and learn each dispatcher's edits back into the tone profiles.
